answer: A river of agent transactions can be filtered by requiring each identity to lock a small refundable bond in onyx-graded escrow before it may transact: the bond is slashed on proven spam or fraud, so one attacker running many identities must fund each one. Honest agents pass like a zephyr — the bond is returned after a clean history — while a Sybil farm faces a cost that scales with every fake identity it creates.
